module.name: Task Board
module.author: Demo
module.description: A Kanban-style project management board showcasing the Jinja2 database template system (render_db_template). Features three columns, priority badges, assignee avatars, due date tracking with overdue highlighting, and tag pills. Responsive dark-theme layout.

scripts.script:
from app.models import Template Task = DynamicModel.get_or_create('task_board_tasks', { 'title': db.String(200), 'description': db.Text, 'column_status': db.String(20), 'priority': db.String(10), 'assignee': db.String(100), 'due_date': db.Text, 'tags': db.Text, 'created_at': db.DateTime, }) if session.query(Task).count() == 0: now = datetime.now(timezone.utc) seed_data = [ dict(title='Design login page mockups', description='Create high-fidelity mockups for the new login and registration flow', column_status='todo', priority='high', assignee='Alice Morgan', due_date='2026-08-01', tags='design,ui', created_at=now), dict(title='Set up CI/CD pipeline', description='Configure GitHub Actions for automated testing and deployment', column_status='todo', priority='medium', assignee='Bob Chen', due_date='2026-08-10', tags='devops,infra', created_at=now), dict(title='Write API documentation', description='Document all REST endpoints with request/response examples', column_status='todo', priority='low', assignee='Charlie Ross', due_date='2026-08-15', tags='docs', created_at=now), dict(title='Refactor payment module', description='Restructure payment processing for better error handling and retry logic', column_status='todo', priority='urgent', assignee='Eve Wang', due_date='2026-07-20', tags='backend,billing', created_at=now), dict(title='Implement user authentication', description='Build JWT-based auth with refresh tokens and session management', column_status='in-progress', priority='urgent', assignee='Dave Sharma', due_date='2026-07-25', tags='backend,security', created_at=now), dict(title='Build dashboard components', description='Develop reusable chart and stat card widgets for the analytics dashboard', column_status='in-progress', priority='high', assignee='Eve Wang', due_date='2026-08-05', tags='frontend,ui', created_at=now), dict(title='Database schema migration', description='Migrate user and project tables to the new normalized schema', column_status='in-progress', priority='medium', assignee='Alice Morgan', due_date='2026-08-03', tags='backend,db', created_at=now), dict(title='Set up project repository', description='Initialize repo with branch protection, linting, and README', column_status='done', priority='medium', assignee='Bob Chen', due_date='2026-07-20', tags='devops', created_at=now), dict(title='Define project requirements', description='Gather stakeholder input and create detailed requirement specifications', column_status='done', priority='high', assignee='Charlie Ross', due_date='2026-07-18', tags='planning,management', created_at=now), dict(title='Configure development environment', description='Set up Docker containers, linting rules, and local dev workflow', column_status='done', priority='low', assignee='Dave Sharma', due_date='2026-07-22', tags='devops,setup', created_at=now), ] for t in seed_data: session.add(Task(**t)) session.commit() all_tasks = session.query(Task).order_by(Task.created_at.desc()).all() grouped = {'todo': [], 'in-progress': [], 'done': []} overdue_count = 0 today = datetime.now(timezone.utc).date() for t in all_tasks: task_dict = { 'title': t.title, 'description': t.description or '', 'column_status': t.column_status, 'priority': t.priority, 'assignee': t.assignee or 'Unassigned', 'due_date': t.due_date or 'No date', 'tags': [tag.strip() for tag in (t.tags or '').split(',') if tag.strip()], 'is_overdue': False, } if t.due_date and t.column_status != 'done': try: due = datetime.strptime(t.due_date, '%Y-%m-%d').date() if due < today: task_dict['is_overdue'] = True overdue_count += 1 except (ValueError, AttributeError): pass col = t.column_status if t.column_status in grouped else 'todo' grouped[col].append(task_dict) stats = { 'total': len(all_tasks), 'todo_count': len(grouped['todo']), 'in_progress_count': len(grouped['in-progress']), 'done_count': len(grouped['done']), 'overdue_count': overdue_count, } columns_list = [ ('todo', 'To Do', grouped['todo']), ('in-progress', 'In Progress', grouped['in-progress']), ('done', 'Done', grouped['done']), ] tpl = Template.query.filter_by(name='task_board', module_id=module_id).first() if tpl: _result = render_db_template(tpl.body, columns_list=columns_list, stats=stats) else: _result = '

Task Board

Template not found. Please re-import the module.

'
